sloka: चालयन्तं महानीकं विधमन्तं महारथान्।ददृशुस्ते न वै रामं वातं वनगतं यथा ।। ६.९४.२१ ।।
transliteration: cālayantaṁ mahānīkaṁ vidhamantaṁ mahārathān।dadṛśuste na vai rāmaṁ vātaṁ vanagataṁ yathā ।। 6.94.21 ।।

translations.english: They could not see Rama while he was moving and breaking huge chariots as one would not be able to see the trees in the forest when the wind blew fast.
